title: Joining King Oliver and the Savoy in New York
summary: Having mastered banjo, he left the boat, joined King Oliver's band in St. Louis and went to New York, with a double engagement at the Savoy alongside Chick Webb.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: When you started on guitar, did you start with music or did you just pick it up without?

Well, I knew music already. You already knew it. Oh, yes. When I started my banjo, well, I made good on banjo. I started banjo playing. You know, rated. I left the boat. And I came down here. Oliver sent for me. And I left here from New Orleans and went to St. Louis. It was the King Oliver Band from Chicago. Did St. Louis. From St. Louis to New York. I stayed up there four, five months. And we had double engagement there at Savoy. You know, New York.
Chick Webb was there then at that time. Each band played a half an hour. You know Chick Webb.
I used to hear his band. I couldn't remember all that set up.
Oh, no. No, don't worry about that.
